description: Read-only lookups in Thunderbird's Global Search (Gloda) full-text index.

functions.name: isAvailable
functions.description: True when Global Search indexing is switched on.

functions.name: attachmentInfo
functions.description: Whether messages have attachments, from header flags and the index, without opening them. Resolves to [{id, has}]; unknown ids are left out.

functions.name: search
functions.description: Searches the index once per term. Resolves to [{term, ids, complete}] where ids are WebExtension message ids, newest first.
